Which single simple object gives you the greatest mechanical advantage? Most people will probably think of a lever, and indeed levers provide a massive mechanical advantage. All you need is a fulcrum upon which to place your lever. But there’s a problem with levers. Their greatest strength is also their greatest weakness. With more length comes more power, yes, but the longer the lever the easier it is to break. Sometimes a much shorter tool is better suited to the job. The humble fulcrum is much stronger than the lever. That’s because a fulcrum is essentially a wedge.
